draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.25, the 63rd-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 6th of 11 at QB. He went 8th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (63rd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Tua Tagovailoa. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (84th percentile), vertical jump (93rd percentile), broad jump (92nd percentile). College production: his final season (2023) ranked 1st in passing yards among the 11 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Atlanta Falcons. 14 career games and 12 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. Still developing: 6 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: interceptions thrown 3 (95th percentile), sacks taken 13 (93rd percentile). Weak spots: rushing yards 70 (12th percentile), passing yards 1,982 (18th percentile). Played 9 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-2 quarterback who played: 1,982 passing yards against a median of 1,765, above the norm.
